_about: C-23: offsets into SaveBlock2 (section 0) and SaveBlock1 (sections 1-4, end to end), read from global.h's own struct comments; flag numbers resolved from flags.h. A flag below daemons_flags_start is a bit in SaveBlock1's flags, one at or above it a bit in SaveBlock2's daemonsFlags. INDEX flags are by national number minus one. Money is stored XOR the encryption key. A daemon is SEEN only when sb2 index_seen and sb1 seen1 and seen2 all have its bit (pokedex_screen.c's anticheat), so a writer sets all three.
